sections.h2: Billing and revenue management, end to end

blocks.text: Revenue in telecom moves through many hands before it reaches the bank. You get each step from one vendor, so nothing is lost between systems.

items: **Sell:** build offers and bundles once, promotions included, and sell them in every channel
**Charge:** rate every session in real time, across data, voice and messaging
**Bill:** convergent invoices for every account and service, in any currency
**Assure:** collect usage, reconcile it and catch leakage before it reaches the invoice
**Collect:** automated reminders, with holds and restores tied to payment
**Settle:** pay partners, MVNOs and carriers what they are owed, and no more

blocks.text: The full **BSS** for large, complex operations: convergent billing and revenue management, with CRM built in on one platform.
A defined launch package for new MVNOs: self-care, CRM, billing, charging and mobile POS in one offer.

sections.h2: Where Alepo fits in your **OSS/BSS** stack

blocks.text: Billing depends on the network. Alepo's **BSS telecom** suite connects directly to its own access and provisioning products, and to the **OSS** you already run, through open APIs. Services activate the moment they are sold, and usage arrives ready to rate.

sections.h2: Why operators choose Alepo telecom billing software

items: **Convergent by design:** fixed, mobile, Wi-Fi and enterprise services on one bill
**Real time:** charging and policy decisions made in the session rather than at month end
**Modular:** start with one product, add the rest when you are ready
Deploy your way: cloud native on Kubernetes, in your environment or run for you by Alepo
**AI Agent Assist (beta):** explains bills and barring to care agents from the live account

items.a: Telecom billing software rates usage and applies plans and discounts, then produces invoices for subscribers and partners. Current platforms also handle real-time charging and collections, plus settlement.

items.q: What is the difference between BSS and OSS?
items.a: BSS runs the business side: products, orders, charging, billing and customer care. OSS runs the network side: inventory, activation and service assurance.

items.q: Does Alepo support prepaid and postpaid on one platform?
items.a: Yes. Online Charging and Digital BSS handle prepaid, postpaid and hybrid plans on one platform.

items.q: Can Alepo replace our legacy billing system in stages?
items.a: Yes. Each product runs on its own, so operators often migrate one function at a time.
